| **_Arizona Daily Star _**
Local opinion: Veteran credits Ciscomani’s office with protecting his benefits As a veteran, I can count on Congressman Juan Ciscomani to fight for me. Last year, I faced the potential loss of my 100% disability rating. Ciscomani's team stepped in to submit an inquiry to the Department of Veterans Affairs on my behalf. Because of their tireless efforts, I did not lose my rating. Not only did Ciscomani's team get me the help I needed, they still check in with me periodically to see if there is anything else I might need help with.

I also received one of the congressman's Veteran Servant Leader Awards in May, recognizing my time serving in the U.S. Navy and the years I spent as a firefighter afterward. This truly meant so much to me, and I really appreciate the congressman taking the time to recognize the sacrifice and service of veterans across Southern Arizona.

My experience with Congressman Ciscomani and his entire team has been nothing but amazing, and I am beyond grateful to know that my congressman will go to bat for veterans like myself.

With the election coming up in just a matter of weeks, I am proud to support Congressman Ciscomani. I have told my family and friends about everything he has done for me and have encouraged every one of them to vote for Ciscomani in November.

Not only has our congressman helped countless veterans like myself by making sure we receive the benefits we have earned, but he also fights for us in Congress by giving us a voice in Washington.

His voting record and the bills he has introduced show a clear pattern of advocating for veterans in Southern Arizona and beyond. There is no question that Congressman Ciscomani has put in the work for us here at home. His continued commitment to supply the support we need to live a happy and healthy life after our time in service does not go unnoticed.

To say that our congressman supports veterans is an extreme understatement. He has fought from his first day in office to ensure that the thousands of veterans who call this district home are heard and advocated for.

I want to say thank you to Congressman Ciscomani and his whole team for what they do day in and day out for veterans. After our time in uniform has ended, life goes on, but with a unique set of challenges. I am so grateful for Congressman Ciscomani's dedication to helping me navigate those challenges. Because of him, I know my concerns are heard. Never in my life have I heard, "Thank you for your service" as much as I have from the congressman and his team.

So thank you, Congressman Ciscomani, for the work you have done and continue to do so that I and all other veterans in Arizona's 6th District have the tools and resources we need.

I am especially looking forward to casting my vote for Congressman Ciscomani on Nov. 3, and encourage all veterans to do the same.

---|---|---
We [packed the room](https://substack.com/redirect/2f819493-fe01-4ab6-a61d-e6b07cf402da?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in Raleigh this week for a campaign luncheon with Attorney General Jeff Jackson. Photos below. It was a great afternoon.
Jeff and I go back a ways. We served together in the state Senate, got elected to Congress in the same year, and watched the same Republican supermajority gerrymander both of us out of our seats. Neither of us quit. He ran statewide and won. I'm taking office as Wake County's District Attorney on January 1st. There was something pretty satisfying about both of us standing there. Just a little bit of payback for the folks who thought gerrymandering would end our careers.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c08352cc-e77c-47bf-8f4a-826989cd1fd3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
[Standing in that room](https://substack.com/redirect/50c070d4-8aa4-4e99-8d31-abb3040c39e1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) got me thinking about the job ahead. So here's the thing I've been saying over and over, and it's the thing that matters most for the safety of every family in Wake County.
The Wake County's District Attorney's Office is funded for 45 prosecutors. [The state judicial branch says the office needs 70](https://substack.com/redirect/a71816bd-ae95-47f6-a30c-eaecbea66256?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). That puts us at 64 percent of full staffing, dead last out of 42 prosecutorial districts in North Carolina.
Mecklenburg County has 95 prosecutors for a smaller county. **45 for Wake, 95 for Mecklenburg.** That works out to an average caseload of 2,600 cases a year in Wake County, compared to just over 1,070 in Mecklenburg and Durham. More than double the caseload, same state, same laws.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b0432da4-ea09-401a-ae55-3d39490acf33?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
When the [state budget funded 18 new prosecutor positions](https://substack.com/redirect/74383391-d753-4ee5-bd56-a849d699bf69?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) this year, Wake County got none of them. Zero. The largest county in North Carolina, the county that handles more than 115,000 cases a year, and not one new position.
Senate leader Phil Berger told reporters that budget writers [simply forgot](https://substack.com/redirect/1bbe8eea-0ba0-4c2b-9b14-a94b2658f90c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Then lawmakers came back to Raleigh to pass a technical corrections bill, which is the bill you use to fix the things you forgot. Wake still got nothing. That tells you that Wake County was specifically targeted by the NC General Assembly. Those positions were in the Senate Republican budget and the full state budget just days before it was released.
What they did find money for? $1.2 million for Special Assistant United States Attorneys. [The State of North Carolina now funds 12 of those positions](https://substack.com/redirect/74383391-d753-4ee5-bd56-a849d699bf69?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Your state tax dollars paying for federal prosecutors, **work Donald Trump 's Department of Justice should be paying for.**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/74383391-d753-4ee5-bd56-a849d699bf69?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
I want to talk about what this actually means for your safety here in Wake County.
It means victims will have to wait years rather than months for justice. It means repeat offenders will stay out on the streets much longer waiting on a new trial.
It means continuances. A case gets pushed because the prosecutor handling it is in another courtroom. Then it gets pushed again. Witnesses move. Memories fade. Some cases get resolved on terms nobody's happy with, not because it's justice, but because there just aren't enough prosecutors to try them.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/9202d24f-518e-4ac0-89ff-83dc658771a0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
It means our Wake County jail stays overcrowded, [which I've written about before](https://substack.com/redirect/9202d24f-518e-4ac0-89ff-83dc658771a0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and that's dangerous for detention officers and for everyone else inside.
It means a victim calls the office and doesn't hear back for a week because the prosecutor who's supposed to call them is carrying over 2,600 cases a year.
It means good prosecutors burn out and leave, which makes the math worse for everyone else who's still there. **And it means cases will fall through the cracks.**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/0528b7eb-eed9-40f0-9370-8c980244cb1e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
[ I spent years as a defense attorney](https://substack.com/redirect/8c4475f4-0456-4b6a-8f88-1dbcb6ab3389?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in Wake County courtrooms before my time as a state senator and Congressman. I've watched this from the other side. A justice system that runs this thin is bad for defendants too. Cases sitting on a docket for over two years serve nobody.
So that's the job. Come January 1st I'll be sworn in and will continue making the case for the resources this office needs, to the county, to the city, and to the General Assembly. And I'll be honest with you about what we can and can't do with what we've got. I'm hopeful you will tell your state and county representatives that you support funding for the Wake DA's Office too.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/6215cee1-4a81-41e7-aa4b-baf17987708a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Having Jeff in the room this week meant a lot to me. He's got his own version of this fight at the state level. It helps to know people who understand the job. He also mentioned he's a Wake County resident now, and that he wants a fully funded DA's office here too, for his own family and for all the folks who work at the NC Attorney General's Office down the street.
Thanks again to everyone who came out. If you can [chip in](https://substack.com/redirect/45f1b6c4-eda7-438a-bf52-9fab2c8df296?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), it helps me keep telling voters what's really going on at the Wake DA's Office and keep the pressure on until it gets the resources it needs.
More soon on the transition.
Wiley

**P.S.** I recently posted about Gen. Chris Donahue after Pete Hegseth forced him out of the Army. That post has been viewed millions of times on social media. ### OUR BIGGEST FUNDRAISER OF THE YEAR!
---
| | | | |
,**This is big, big, big!** We are honored to announce that **legendary Twins Hall of Fame broadcaster Dick Bremer** will headline our fundraiser on Thursday, October 1 at the Rose Creek Event Center in Fargo.
Dick Bremer called Twins games for 40 years in Twins Territory, and we couldn’t be happier to have him with us to kick off October.
In addition, we will have a Twins memorabilia silent auction, special guests, and food and fun for all.
Your suggested donation of $100 covers your ticket! We’d love to have you join us.
**Who/What:** Dick Bremer and Vern Thompson Signature Fundraiser**When:** Thursday, October 1 5:30-8:30pm**Where:** Rose Creek Event Center, 1500 East Rose Creek Pkwy S in Fargo|

subject: We’re Growing — and I Need Your Help Reaching Voters
body:
Thank You for Powering This Grassroots Campaign
| | | | |
---

---
| |
---
| Friends and neighbors, thank you for the amazing support you have shown this campaign. I am so proud of how far we've gotten without compromising principles or begging for donations. I have some of the best volunteers and friends anyone could ask for, and I could not be more blessed.
I have ordered another batch of signs, and I have been so fortunate to meet local neighbors who want to help share my message. This campaign is powered by people, not PACs or special interests. I am committed to keeping it grassroots, independent, and accountable to the community.
Because I am working hard to keep costs down and remain truly independent of PAC funds and special interest groups, the one thing I could really use right now is volunteers to hand out palm cards at early voting stations. Even an hour or two of your time would make a meaningful difference.
I also want to be transparent about a real challenge we have faced: my ability to reach local neighbors has been severely hampered because the Nextdoor platform suspended my account. Nextdoor is based in San Francisco, and the moderator who had me banned lives in Japan. When local candidates are blocked from communicating with voters in their own communities, it raises serious concerns about how elections can be influenced, and it needs to be exposed and stopped.
You can help by sharing my emails and website on your social media pages, and by introducing me to your family, friends, and neighbors so I can continue reaching voters directly.
I have signed the term limit pledge, and I will never take money from foreign interests. If you would like to help, please shoot me an email or direct message. Thank you for everything you have done to share my message, support this campaign, and stand with me.
With faith, gratitude, and determination,
Shelly Arnoldi Candidate for Virginia's 8th Congressional District shellyarnoldi4va.org 202-285-7474

In this training, _Meeting the Moment: From Sorority Leadership to Elected Offic_ e, participants explored the issues that matter most to them and identified ways to deepen their civic and political involvement in their own communities.

They also learned concrete steps they can take to pursue an appointment to a board or commission, participate in local and statewide policymaking, and move toward running for office.

If you ever doubted we could win America's youth back from the Left...

If you ever wondered whether we'd lost the next generation for good...

If you ever sat up at night -- watching the news, seeing what's happening in our schools, our culture, our country -- and thought, _" Is it already too late?" _

You're not alone.

A lot of good people have been asking the same question.

**But I want to tell you something that might just change how you feel about the future of this country... **

Just one year ago, Turning Point USA's high school program -- which is now called "Club America" -- was in about 1,200 schools.

That was no small feat.

Starting a single chapter today takes serious courage. Students get mocked. Threatened. Investigated. Sometimes even physically attacked.

So reaching 1,200 chapters already felt like a miracle.

_Then Charlie called me... _

He said: "Andrew, I love what we're doing with our high school program -- but we've got to move faster."

I told him, "We are."

Charlie replied, "No you're not thinking what I'm thinking... I want to be in 35,000 high schools."

I laughed. I told him, "Charlie, there aren't even 35,000 high schools in America."

"Okay," he said, "How many are there?"

"About 27,000."

Without skipping a beat, Charlie said, "Okay, great. Let's do 27,000!"
I'll be honest -- I froze.

We didn't have the numbers. We didn't have the staff. We didn't have the roadmap yet.

But he wasn't fazed.

He said, "Don't worry. We'll figure it out. We'll do it together."

That was Charlie.

He didn't think small. He didn't move slow. He didn't settle for "maybe someday."

He believed in going now.

And he believed that if the mission was right, the path would reveal itself.

He chased what others only dreamed about... and turned what others thought impossible into reality.

That's why he built Turning Point USA in the first place.

That's why tens of thousands of students were inspired by Charlie to start chapters of their own -- _many in schools where they were explicitly told not to. _

Two Unrelated Bets Are Both Live This Week, and Neither Is the Fed

| | Rotation Signal 01 — Oil's Break Below $100 Confirms Friday's Shipping Data Was the Real Signal
---|---
**Our interpretation:** this newsletter argued over the weekend that the fourfold recovery in Hormuz throughput was a more meaningful de-escalation signal than the market had yet absorbed. Monday's break below the $100 psychological level is consistent with that thesis playing out in the headline price. **What remains unknown** is whether this is a durable repricing or a diplomacy-driven rally vulnerable to reversal if this week's UN and Beijing meetings disappoint.
| | Rotation Signal 02 — A New, Distinct Trade to Watch: Rare Earths and Semiconductors
---|---
**Verified fact:** China's suspension of rare-earth export controls expires November 10, and Thursday's summit is expected to address extending that suspension alongside a pending $14 billion Taiwan arms sale and AI cooperation talks. **Our interpretation:** this is a genuinely separate rotation story from this month's energy-and-rates narrative — semiconductor, EV, and defense-sector positioning will likely trade on Thursday's summit outcome independent of whatever happens with oil prices or the Fed this week.
| | Rotation Signal 03 — Two Binary Events in One Week Raise the Stakes for Volatility
---|---
**Current classification: PRESSURE, with two independent catalysts converging on the same week.** A possible Trump-Pezeshkian UN encounter and Thursday's Trump-Xi summit are each capable of moving markets meaningfully regardless of the other's outcome. Positioning that assumes both go well, both go poorly, or a mixed outcome will each imply different plays across energy, technology, and defense-linked names.
| | What to Watch This Week
---|---
Whether oil's break below $100 holds through the UN General Assembly week, and how technology and semiconductor names position ahead of Thursday's summit on rare-earth export policy.

body:
They are not buying a verdict. They are buying my calendar, my attention, and my team's nerve.

| [ ](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckbuO3DAMRb9G7mToYdnjwkWAwXSbNqVBS7RHiPWARM0gfx94g21TbMlLHhIH_PWxfoA_fTx-QsDF17qWutITT3jX5qm-sWDEFxbYUqNVCTVyMXMlV7DkX7gO0LnFKHnbbx0ucpqFkGLWpnsumxvNIOWgxIzTtrtZbQakceDQSan3zi_XPjErKSdptO71bp0Z9KSFBH0zkg2iZQeEvY_VO6w2pZzT6cnb2qdydOfyJMqV6R9MPZh6VLStYA8RXaLepsDUI_1G3DGg83CU1PIVhYPTE_9wlyLxN0TiwF9YnLfEw8ZzysD0o1FYa2rFItP3_zFMjdfsdaMFpu-f_L_MQsjgj8j0_cv2q5MiYSSm775WpkYIqX2W2nRlcfntz9PXcWKDOAL489Lp6JtPei3qbwAAAP__JTOlxw)

Dear Patriot,
[](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckbuO3DAMRb9G7mToYdnjwkWAwXSbNqVBS7RHiPWARM0gfx94g21TbMlLHhIH_PWxfoA_fTx-QsDF17qWutITT3jX5qm-sWDEFxbYUqNVCTVyMXMlV7DkX7gO0LnFKHnbbx0ucpqFkGLWpnsumxvNIOWgxIzTtrtZbQakceDQSan3zi_XPjErKSdptO71bp0Z9KSFBH0zkg2iZQeEvY_VO6w2pZzT6cnb2qdydOfyJMqV6R9MPZh6VLStYA8RXaLepsDUI_1G3DGg83CU1PIVhYPTE_9wlyLxN0TiwF9YnLfEw8ZzysD0o1FYa2rFItP3_zFMjdfsdaMFpu-f_L_MQsjgj8j0_cv2q5MiYSSm775WpkYIqX2W2nRlcfntz9PXcWKDOAL489Lp6JtPei3qbwAAAP__JTOlxw)I want to explain something about the lawsuits, because almost everybody misunderstands what they are actually for. **They are not trying to win.** Look at the record. **AFT v. O'Keefe. Koerber v. O'Keefe** , all the way to the California Supreme Court. **Teter v. O'Keefe. Democracy Partners v. O'Keefe** , in the D.C. Circuit Court of Appeals. **Every single person who has sued me has lost.** And the most recent one was not decided on a technicality. A federal appeals court in Washington threw out the jury verdict against me and held that **undercover reporting like ours is protected by the First Amendment.** For fifteen years I was told that what I do is not legitimate journalism. A federal court has now concluded otherwise, in writing. The people filing these cases can read that record as easily as you can. **They know exactly how it ends. They file anyway.** So ask the obvious question. If you already know you are going to lose, what are you actually purchasing? **[You are purchasing my calendar, and I want to show you the receipt.](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckbuO3DAMRb9G7mToYdnjwkWAwXSbNqVBS7RHiPWARM0gfx94g21TbMlLHhIH_PWxfoA_fTx-QsDF17qWutITT3jX5qm-sWDEFxbYUqNVCTVyMXMlV7DkX7gO0LnFKHnbbx0ucpqFkGLWpnsumxvNIOWgxIzTtrtZbQakceDQSan3zi_XPjErKSdptO71bp0Z9KSFBH0zkg2iZQeEvY_VO6w2pZzT6cnb2qdydOfyJMqV6R9MPZh6VLStYA8RXaLepsDUI_1G3DGg83CU1PIVhYPTE_9wlyLxN0TiwF9YnLfEw8ZzysD0o1FYa2rFItP3_zFMjdfsdaMFpu-f_L_MQsjgj8j0_cv2q5MiYSSm775WpkYIqX2W2nRlcfntz9PXcWKDOAL489Lp6JtPei3qbwAAAP__JTOlxw)** **[KEEP THE CAMERAS ROLLING — CHIP IN $35](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckbuO3DAMRb9G7mToYdnjwkWAwXSbNqVBS7RHiPWARM0gfx94g21TbMlLHhIH_PWxfoA_fTx-QsDF17qWutITT3jX5qm-sWDEFxbYUqNVCTVyMXMlV7DkX7gO0LnFKHnbbx0ucpqFkGLWpnsumxvNIOWgxIzTtrtZbQakceDQSan3zi_XPjErKSdptO71bp0Z9KSFBH0zkg2iZQeEvY_VO6w2pZzT6cnb2qdydOfyJMqV6R9MPZh6VLStYA8RXaLepsDUI_1G3DGg83CU1PIVhYPTE_9wlyLxN0TiwF9YnLfEw8ZzysD0o1FYa2rFItP3_zFMjdfsdaMFpu-f_L_MQsjgj8j0_cv2q5MiYSSm775WpkYIqX2W2nRlcfntz9PXcWKDOAL489Lp6JtPei3qbwAAAP__JTOlxw)** There are three things a lawsuit buys the person who files it, and a verdict is not one of them. **The first is distraction.** A deposition consumes an entire day. Discovery consumes weeks. There are filings, motions, calls with counsel, documents to locate, and every one of them lands on my desk rather than somebody else's. A day spent in a conference room answering questions about footage I shot three years ago is a day I am not looking at what is in front of us right now. **They cannot stop the next investigation. They can absolutely make me late for it.** **The second is demoralization** , and this one is aimed at my people, not at me. Within days of that federal appeals ruling, **another lawsuit was filed against one of my undercover journalists.** Not against me. Against a young reporter who did the field work. Somebody who never attended law school, has no legal department, and has no corporation standing behind them. Understand the message that sends to every talented young person considering this work. **We can reach you personally. We can put your name on a docket. We can make the next five years of your life expensive and frightening.** **The third is time** , which is the only thing in this business you genuinely cannot replace. Appeals take years. Defenses take years. And they are counting on the arithmetic that a reporter who spends five years defending old work is a reporter who is no longer producing new work. **[That is the entire strategy, and it is working on exactly one front.](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckbuO3DAMRb9G7mToYdnjwkWAwXSbNqVBS7RHiPWARM0gfx94g21TbMlLHhIH_PWxfoA_fTx-QsDF17qWutITT3jX5qm-sWDEFxbYUqNVCTVyMXMlV7DkX7gO0LnFKHnbbx0ucpqFkGLWpnsumxvNIOWgxIzTtrtZbQakceDQSan3zi_XPjErKSdptO71bp0Z9KSFBH0zkg2iZQeEvY_VO6w2pZzT6cnb2qdydOfyJMqV6R9MPZh6VLStYA8RXaLepsDUI_1G3DGg83CU1PIVhYPTE_9wlyLxN0TiwF9YnLfEw8ZzysD0o1FYa2rFItP3_zFMjdfsdaMFpu-f_L_MQsjgj8j0_cv2q5MiYSSm775WpkYIqX2W2nRlcfntz9PXcWKDOAL489Lp6JtPei3qbwAAAP__JTOlxw)** **[YES — FUND THE INVESTIGATIONS THEY WANT STOPPED](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckbuO3DAMRb9G7mToYdnjwkWAwXSbNqVBS7RHiPWARM0gfx94g21TbMlLHhIH_PWxfoA_fTx-QsDF17qWutITT3jX5qm-sWDEFxbYUqNVCTVyMXMlV7DkX7gO0LnFKHnbbx0ucpqFkGLWpnsumxvNIOWgxIzTtrtZbQakceDQSan3zi_XPjErKSdptO71bp0Z9KSFBH0zkg2iZQeEvY_VO6w2pZzT6cnb2qdydOfyJMqV6R9MPZh6VLStYA8RXaLepsDUI_1G3DGg83CU1PIVhYPTE_9wlyLxN0TiwF9YnLfEw8ZzysD0o1FYa2rFItP3_zFMjdfsdaMFpu-f_L_MQsjgj8j0_cv2q5MiYSSm775WpkYIqX2W2nRlcfntz9PXcWKDOAL489Lp6JtPei3qbwAAAP__JTOlxw)** Now I have to be very clear with you, because I do not want a single dollar landing in the wrong place. **I am not writing to you about legal bills.** Our legal defense is funded separately. That is handled, my attorneys are outstanding, and it is not what I am asking you for today. **Please do not send this gift thinking it pays a lawyer, because it does not.** Here is what the lawfare actually costs, and it never shows up on an invoice. **It costs investigations that never happen.** The tip that came in during a week I was buried in discovery. The state I could not put a team into because I was in a deposition on the day the decision had to be made. The story that was live for eleven days and then closed, because the person willing to talk stopped being willing. **Nobody ever sees those. There is no video of the investigation you did not fund.** That is precisely why this strategy is attractive to the people using it. **[The damage is invisible, and I am the only one who can tell you it happened.](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckbuO3DAMRb9G7mToYdnjwkWAwXSbNqVBS7RHiPWARM0gfx94g21TbMlLHhIH_PWxfoA_fTx-QsDF17qWutITT3jX5qm-sWDEFxbYUqNVCTVyMXMlV7DkX7gO0LnFKHnbbx0ucpqFkGLWpnsumxvNIOWgxIzTtrtZbQakceDQSan3zi_XPjErKSdptO71bp0Z9KSFBH0zkg2iZQeEvY_VO6w2pZzT6cnb2qdydOfyJMqV6R9MPZh6VLStYA8RXaLepsDUI_1G3DGg83CU1PIVhYPTE_9wlyLxN0TiwF9YnLfEw8ZzysD0o1FYa2rFItP3_zFMjdfsdaMFpu-f_L_MQsjgj8j0_cv2q5MiYSSm775WpkYIqX2W2nRlcfntz9PXcWKDOAL489Lp6JtPei3qbwAAAP__JTOlxw)** ****[CHIP IN $35 AND PUT IT IN THE FIELD](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckbuO3DAMRb9G7mToYdnjwkWAwXSbNqVBS7RHiPWARM0gfx94g21TbMlLHhIH_PWxfoA_fTx-QsDF17qWutITT3jX5qm-sWDEFxbYUqNVCTVyMXMlV7DkX7gO0LnFKHnbbx0ucpqFkGLWpnsumxvNIOWgxIzTtrtZbQakceDQSan3zi_XPjErKSdptO71bp0Z9KSFBH0zkg2iZQeEvY_VO6w2pZzT6cnb2qdydOfyJMqV6R9MPZh6VLStYA8RXaLepsDUI_1G3DGg83CU1PIVhYPTE_9wlyLxN0TiwF9YnLfEw8ZzysD0o1FYa2rFItP3_zFMjdfsdaMFpu-f_L_MQsjgj8j0_cv2q5MiYSSm775WpkYIqX2W2nRlcfntz9PXcWKDOAL489Lp6JtPei3qbwAAAP__JTOlxw)**** So let me tell you how this actually gets beaten, because it is simpler than it sounds. There is exactly one measurement of whether their strategy worked. **Did O'Keefe Media Group publish more this year, or less?** That is the scoreboard. clean_body: We can win across rural America with a bold economic vision.| | | | Peter, When I traveled across Pennsylvania this summer, from Philadelphia to rural communities to factory towns, I heard the same message again and again: People are frustrated with the status quo—and they are ready for change. to elect candidates nationwide who will put working people first. That means showing up everywhere, listening to voters, and offering a bold, fresh economic vision for working families. = = While Republicans choose to engage in costly foreign wars, we need Democrats who aren’t afraid to fight for a bold, progressive platform that puts everyday Americans first. That means: ✅ An industrial bank that invests in American manufacturing ✅ Medicare for All ✅ A tax on billionaires ✅ Free childcare That is how we lower costs, create good-paying jobs, and rebuild communities that Washington has ignored for far too long. Americans do not want more excuses from the same broken system. They want a government that works on behalf of working people—not billionaires, corporations, or special interests. But having the right message is not enough. We need to organize, mobilize, and give people a reason to show up and vote in November. We will win across factory towns and rural America in November—but only if we build the movement to do it. = = Thank you for your support, your activism, and all that you do. Onward, Ro P.S. Please take a minute to in the New York Times. Text me at 650-999-9610 to let me know what you think. | | | | | | | Wait! One more thing– Ro doesn't accept a cent from lobbyists or PACs, meaning our work is completely funded by grassroots supporters like you. By donating just $3 today, you’re helping us create a country that works for everyone, not just those at the top. That means a renewed investment in American manufacturing, Medicare for All, student debt relief, and a green future. If you want to support our people-powered campaign as we continue to fight for progress in Washington, please consider making a donation of $3 or more today. name: Jace Yarbrough
subject: I am fighting a great evil
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Yarbrough for Congress
body:
I am fighting a great evil, and I cannot stop.

I am fighting a great evil, and I cannot stop.
| ["For we do not wrestle against flesh and blood, but against the rulers, against the authorities, against the cosmic powers over this present darkness, against the spiritual forces of evil."](https://trk.email.todaysdispatch.)[Ephesians 6:12](https://trk.email.todaysdispatch._mufzpGj0zTy33dz4O3dew)
Friend,
Kneeling in prayer a few weeks ago, it hit me plainly. I am fighting a great evil, and I cannot stop.
I'm Jace Yarbrough - candidate for Congress.
[Three facts shape my life: I am a Christian, a husband, and a father of five.](https://trk.email.todaysdispatch.)
I also served in the Air Force, where I saw how Biden's COVID mandates had nothing to do with defending this country and everything to do with control. Twice, I stood up to my own chain of command to defend my faith.
It cost me, but it showed me who we're up against.
As a constitutional lawyer, I have fought for first responders forced to choose between their jobs and their conscience, and for minors targeted by abortion providers.
My wife Elizabeth and I even founded a Christian school because we refused to hand our kids over to a system that no longer shares our values.
America is in a battle between good and evil. Between freedom and godless communism, fighting to own our kids, our conscience, and our future.
I won't pretend I'm not afraid sometimes. But silence is how evil wins.
[I'm fighting to change this broken system once and for all. ](https://trk.email.todaysdispatch.)
[Sadly, nothing seems to cost more these days than running for public office. The honest truth is, I grew up with very little, and don't have bags of dark money like my opponent. ](https://trk.email.todaysdispatch.-K5G0gzpKIPwv7w)
[My filing deadline to take this message to DC hits Friday at midnight, and I need real strength to win this.](https://trk.email.todaysdispatch.-es7t2utGTgxHZrHWHRg)
[Whatever you can give, $25, $50, $100, is an act of faith that this nation is still worth saving. Every hour we wait, the other side gets louder.](https://trk.email.todaysdispatch.)
You will be what makes my race. I thank you in advance and leave you with this:

I know who goes before us, and I know we were not made to be afraid.
Jesus Christ is our strength.
God bless America.
Jace YarbroughCandidate for Congress

On Friday, September 18, President Trump banned CNN, MS NOW, and Politico from the White House grounds -- "effective immediately," he said, because they "purposely write fake news" about him. By Saturday their reporters were being turned away at the gates and having credentials confiscated on the sidewalk. By Monday the three outlets had notified the government they were suing, demanding full access back -- including the right to operate the video pool. The White House TV pool suspended its coverage of Trump events in protest. And the White House Correspondents' Association -- its president is Fox News's own Jacqui Heinrich -- demanded access be "immediately restored," with Fox News Media signing the joint protest statement alongside the networks and the papers.
Everyone is arguing about the same thing, but almost nobody names it: not whether journalists may write or broadcast about the president -- nobody is stopping that -- but whether certain reporters must be given a seat inside the West Wing. That second thing is not a right. It never was. It is a courtesy, extended president by president, and every square foot of it can be taken back.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/67dbc593-cfcd-486a-86a9-79c70cfc903d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The history is unambiguous. Washington had no press corps; reporters parsed his messages in partisan papers. The modern arrangement began as an accommodation under McKinley, whose secretary Cortelyou made time for the newspapermen. Theodore Roosevelt gave them a room. Wilson began regular press conferences in 1913; when he rationed access, the reporters organized the White House Correspondents' Association in 1914 -- a private club, not a statutory body. FDR gave the corps its workspace and held conferences twice a week. Every generation of presidents has granted access on the president's own terms -- and trimmed it when displeased.
The swimming pool is the perfect symbol, because the briefing room literally is a former pool. In 1933, friends of Franklin Roosevelt paid for an indoor pool so the polio-stricken president could swim for therapy. Truman, Kennedy, and above all Lyndon Johnson used it -- LBJ, by many accounts, preferred no suit at all, drafted aides into the water, and conducted business from the deep end, famously photographed in the pool with his dog, Yuki.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/73c96f01-6a4f-4f42-9155-09063a9b5e6f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Nixon didn't swim -- "not indoors nor in fresh water," one profile sniffed -- so in 1970 he had the pool covered over with flooring and handed the room to a television-age press corps. In 2000 it was christened the James S. Brady Press Briefing Room. When renovators later pulled up the floor, they found the pool still down there: tiles, ladder, and mural, sealed beneath the seats of the people now suing to stay in them.
Which brings us to the law. There is no statute creating the press pool, the briefing room, or reserved seats for favored outlets. The strongest case law -- Sherrill v. Knight (1977), CNN v. Trump (2018), AP v. Budowich (2025) -- says only that the government cannot deny a press pass arbitrarily. It does not say the press owns the room. The WHCA ran the pool rosters for decades because presidents allowed it; in 2025, Trump moved the rotation into the White House itself. Courts can order credentials restored -- they have before -- but no judge can order a president to hold briefings, staff a pool, or keep the room open at all. The whole apparatus exists at presidential pleasure.
That is why the endgame here is real. If judges keep ordering reporters back through the gates, the president holds the ultimate veto -- and history shows exactly what he can do with it, because the room is fungible. Nixon proved it in 1970: one day a swimming pool, the next day a briefing theater. It can go back the same way. Under the floorboards of the Brady room sits a drained, tiled pool with a harbor mural on the wall. Empty the chairs, peel up the floor, and the White House has its pool again -- LBJ's pool, skinny-dipping optional, occupied by the people it was built for in the first place.
There is one more irony the current solidarity march should note. In 2009, the Obama White House froze Fox News out of a single interview, and the bureau chiefs of ABC, CBS, NBC, and CNN stood up and forced a reversal -- because access denied to one is leverage against all. In 2026, Fox leads the defense of CNN, MS NOW, and Politico. Good for them. But solidarity runs on the same fuel as the room itself: presidential goodwill. When that runs dry, the press discovers the difference between freedom of the press and a press office at 1600 Pennsylvania Avenue.
The First Amendment guarantees the right to publish, not the right to an office in the president's house. Presidents give the press its perch; presidents can withdraw it. That isn't tyranny -- it's the building's own history, sitting under the briefing room floor, drained and waiting.

We gave seniors real relief - **NO TAX** on the benefits they earned. Now the radical Democrats are circling like vultures do to their prey. **__[They want to put the tax right back on your Social Security. It’s disgusting.](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyc0MFuhCAUheGnwR0GkKIuWDRp7Gra2XVpEO7obVAJ3BnTt2-cpC_Q_cmfL-frMl4cRtzmD7eCnfeUxlzGY8EIeLiCGy1wQKEDtxnLMiqhDBc9V3J0nvABo3ZVsNoZbYypwMq2F0IqLUW12NAFKV3XTZOT8tY3k_am9ROEpnsRQjUV2jMoeiVlq4XoammgNW2Y-l7BzfSGaQEBac_1actQMMBG6GLt97WKdiFKhTWvTA1MDQX8PUN94JYhnAumBsr3NfHNEe6bi9zv64pEAPz75pkaYuIpl8RhdRh52T26yJ8dpB_-kIanPbFmuNM6kmfN2_vn9cr_1FW2IR0YIxbTMi3ms_Kk0X_PfFj1GwAA__8u4IZ5)__**
If they take back the House and the Senate majority, you can count on them to do just that.

[SAVE NO TAX ON SOCIAL SECURITY](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyc0MFuhCAUheGnwR0GkKIuWDRp7Gra2XVpEO7obVAJ3BnTt2-cpC_Q_cmfL-frMl4cRtzmD7eCnfeUxlzGY8EIeLiCGy1wQKEDtxnLMiqhDBc9V3J0nvABo3ZVsNoZbYypwMq2F0IqLUW12NAFKV3XTZOT8tY3k_am9ROEpnsRQjUV2jMoeiVlq4XoammgNW2Y-l7BzfSGaQEBac_1actQMMBG6GLt97WKdiFKhTWvTA1MDQX8PUN94JYhnAumBsr3NfHNEe6bi9zv64pEAPz75pkaYuIpl8RhdRh52T26yJ8dpB_-kIanPbFmuNM6kmfN2_vn9cr_1FW2IR0YIxbTMi3ms_Kk0X_PfFj1GwAA__8u4IZ5)
This is no longer politics. **They've crossed the line.**
This is a direct threat to the money our seniors need for food, water, medicine, and to keep the lights on.
**_I will not stand by and let them do it._**
**_I know you won’t either, Friend_**

Once Democrats get power, they won’t stop at Social Security. If they control Congress, they will reverse everything we’ve done to **REVIVE AMERICA.**
**Please, stand with me and the MAGA Movement before it’s too late.**

name: Roy Cooper
subject: JD Vance just left the stage
body:
Since a new poll has this race virtually tied, it seems his and President Trump’s back-to-back, in-person attacks are working.

For that, I am so grateful.
---
**However, we didn’t reach our $200,000 rapid response goal before Vice President Vance took the stage at a North Carolina rally for my MAGA opponent, Michael Whatley.**
After rehashing all the same tired lies about North Carolina and me to rile up the base, he’ll depart for Washington DC any minute now. When he does, the GOP’s super PACs will descend in his place.
Since another new poll just came out with this race virtually tied, it seems his and President Trump’s back-to-back, in-person attacks – _in tandem with the more than $100 million spent to defeat me_ – are working just as planned. They won’t let up anytime soon.
I’ve talked to my team, and we’re extending the deadline to 11:59 p.m. Peter, if we don’t close the gap tonight, we risk falling behind too late in the game to claw back the lead and win – and this is a race we cannot afford to lose.
**Will you please chip in at this link to help me fight back on the airwaves and flip this seat blue? Roy Cooper

# **Scott Bessent: $30B-for-$30B tariff cuts now on Trump 's Xi table**
Treasury Secretary **[Scott Bessent called Sunday talks](https://substack.com/redirect/d2085675-848f-4533-aa73-dcc2775800b9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** with He Lifeng successful and **[floated a 30-30-30](https://substack.com/redirect/cd9e594d-f536-49ba-91e6-366ceb2771ff?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/cd9e594d-f536-49ba-91e6-366ceb2771ff?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)deal for non-critical goods as China confirmed Xi Jinping's Sept. 23-25 state visit.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c23fdff7-89e2-48ef-b8e8-b1eee109f4d3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Trade board now live:** U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer said the U.S.-China Board of Trade is now operationalized, grouping Chinese consumer and low-tech goods against U.S. energy, farm products, and medical devices.
* **AI incident channel opens:** The sides discussed a **[U.S.-China AI Dialogue](https://substack.com/redirect/0e3ecb51-6d9d-4ce8-a9e6-dbfd63422a28?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and a national-security notification channel for uncontrollable agents, non-state cyber actors, and biological risks, with a likely follow-up in Shenzhen.
* **Truce clock hits November:** Bessent called the Nov. 10 end of the temporary trade truce a focal point, including Washington's pause on higher reciprocal tariffs and China's rare-earth and U.S. farm pledges.
* **Andrews greeting this week:** Guo Jiakun said[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/706b6395-e5b8-4a05-a0dc-0889477f1f3b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[it is Xi's first U.S. trip since 2023.](https://substack.com/redirect/706b6395-e5b8-4a05-a0dc-0889477f1f3b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Bessent said Trump will greet him at Joint Base Andrews. Altman, Huang, Dimon, and Fraser are expected at dinner.

# **Scott Bessent to AI labs: no liability shield from Trump**
Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/0e3ecb51-6d9d-4ce8-a9e6-dbfd63422a28?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[told CNBC on Monday](https://substack.com/redirect/0e3ecb51-6d9d-4ce8-a9e6-dbfd63422a28?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** that AI developers "need to take responsibility for themselves," rejecting a federal liability shield as President Donald Trump resists a regulatory crackdown.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c23fdff7-89e2-48ef-b8e8-b1eee109f4d3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Humans remain on hook:** "It is humans who are responsible, not the AI," Bessent said on Squawk Box when asked if he agrees with Trump's opposition to an industry crackdown.
* **Rates tied to war:** After 12 hours with He Lifeng, Bessent said rates should fall once the Iran war ends and oil is more supplied. The Fed last week raised its range to 3.75%-4%.
* **Odd couple warns Hill:** MIT physicist Max Tegmark said a closed-door Senate briefing left him encouraged. A day earlier he introduced Bernie Sanders and Steve Bannon, **[who both said humans should stay in charge.](https://substack.com/redirect/938dd665-5626-4f87-8f76-06edcf37160b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
* **FDA model for AI:** Tegmark pitched an "FDA for AI" and warned Hugging Face-style breakouts by 700 OpenAI agents could become more frequent within 6 months to a year.

# **Anthropic delays its IPO. OpenAI just mapped a $278B burn**
Anthropic is **[pushing its IPO from October to November](https://substack.com/redirect/74503d54-4093-482d-9fd0-3c767ab0067a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** so it can show third-quarter results, while OpenAI forecasts $278 billion of negative free cash from 2026 through 2030.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c23fdff7-89e2-48ef-b8e8-b1eee109f4d3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Delay predates slowdown call:** Sources told the Wall Street Journal the shift was decided before CEO Dario Amodei on Sept. 12 called for a slowdown in frontier AI model development.
* **Industry splits on pacing:** OpenAI's Sam Altman, SpaceX's Elon Musk, and Google DeepMind's Demis Hassabis backed the idea. Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang and President Donald Trump dismissed it.
* **Revenue trails the spend:** OpenAI expects sales to rise from $35 billion in 2026 to $350 billion in 2030, with $856 billion of outlays on AI computing and infrastructure alone.
* **More capital still needed:** OpenAI had $122 billion in funds and is in talks on a raise valuing the company at $1.2 trillion. Altman said last week it would not go public in 2026.

# **Nscale files a $3B IPO after losing $1B in six months**
U.K. AI cloud company Nscale **[filed an S-1 late Friday for a New York IPO](https://substack.com/redirect/630a20db-3c6b-4d24-a487-65a115ee8e46?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** seeking up to $3 billion at roughly a $30 billion valuation, lining up against CoreWeave and Nebius.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c23fdff7-89e2-48ef-b8e8-b1eee109f4d3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Bank group and ticker:** Goldman Sachs, JPMorgan, and Morgan Stanley are lead bookrunners. The company plans to list on the NYSE under the ticker NSCL.
* **Payne spun out Arkon:** CEO Josh Payne formed Nscale in 2024 from Arkon Energy's bitcoin-mining data centers and now rents Nvidia-equipped servers built for AI workloads.
* **Hydro sites, then West:** The firm started on European hydropower, especially in Norway, and is expanding in the U.S., U.K., Portugal, and Iceland.
* **Capacity still scaling up:** Nscale reported 1.37 gigawatts of active and contracted power and plans for 10 gigawatts.

* * *
* * *
# **VW recalls 208,724 SUVs that can lose steering**
Volkswagen Group of America is **[recalling 208,724 U.S. SUVs](https://substack.com/redirect/9c1b2594-85b8-4e65-8056-e5a34d37b8a0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** after NHTSA said a steering-rack mounting bolt can corrode and break, risking a loss of steering control.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c23fdff7-89e2-48ef-b8e8-b1eee109f4d3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Models and build windows:** The recall covers certain 2018 Tiguan, 2018-2019 Atlas, and 2019-2021 Audi Q3 vehicles built with one steering-rack design. Other racks on those nameplates are not included.
* **Moisture corrodes the bolt:** Moisture can reach the right-side mounting bolt and corrode it. If the bolt head fractures, the rack may hang from a single point until the housing breaks.
* **Agency flags crash risk:** NHTSA said a broken steering-rack housing can cause a loss of steering control and raise the crash risk. Volkswagen and Audi said they know of no linked crashes, fires, injuries, or deaths.
* **Dealers replace bolts free:** Dealers will replace the bolt with a polymer-coated, corrosion-resistant part at no cost. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed Nov. 10.

* * *
* * *
# **Intel and Arm jump 12% as Meta 's Muse lights up CPUs**
Intel and Arm Holdings rose early Monday as investors tied the **[popularity of Meta Platforms' Muse AI agent to stronger demand](https://substack.com/redirect/b9ba5fac-4522-4dba-af24-b67f3f0871b4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** for central processing units.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c23fdff7-89e2-48ef-b8e8-b1eee109f4d3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Year-to-date Intel surge:** Intel stock was up 194% this year through Friday's close before the Monday bounce.
* **Arm joins the move:** Arm Holdings was indicated 11.92% higher as traders bet Muse-style agents need more general-purpose compute, not only GPUs.
* **Muse is the trigger:** Barron's said Muse's popularity is what lit the CPU-demand trade in both names.

name: Robert Reich via OnePA
subject: Twelve attorneys general are all that's blocking this media mega-merger
body:
One pro-Trump oligarch family, in control of an even more vast media empire. Twelve states can still stop it. | |
---
Peter, One of the richest families on earth, father-son oligarchs Larry and David Ellison, owners of Paramount Skydance, is on the verge of acquiring Warner Bros. Discovery. **One pro-Trump family, setting priorities for two of the largest news and entertainment companies on earth.** That's the pitch. The Ellisons have told Trump they’ll make "**sweeping changes" at CNN** and **implement the “CBS playbook”** as they take charge at Paramount _and_ Warner, HBO Max (home of **John Oliver**) _and_ Paramount+, Comedy Central (home of **Jon Stewart**), MTV, TNT, TBS, Discovery, the Food Network, and more — while Larry Ellison’s **Oracle manages the algorithm at TikTok** , where one in five Americans now get their news. This deal is bad for everyone except the Ellisons. It will devastate TV and film jobs and hand over control of **which jokes air, which investigations run, and which stories die quietly** to**** one billionaire family aligned with one pro-oligarch president. Trump's DOJ approved this deal in June, but **here’s the good news** : twelve state attorneys general, led by California’s Rob Bonta, sued in July to block it. Now, the Ellisons are pressuring AGs to settle out of court, but we can’t let that happen. [**Send a message to state attorneys general to**** _stay strong_****, demand #NoConcessions, and take the case to trial.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm3_pSBlTmDFVH16Ccc45FCNuU_Ly2vNFTLXn2V-tfVw_RLtdX7DqsGBgXH38fGpQZis4jc0bhLU-wTYn5acTK9OrZ0YetB4cSxC6bntsT4xJMhLx_1Iyduqz0uQVYJHjiAji7KaRrwDsyr1V5kmxC7E34liN3jTkH2bETcLHhc3RbIt3opqGhMu0JJRj9rT3r-W9TSV0boUF5zOoTC553T0x1Mg2ygsEZxrZsoClgHyU0L1esYlsZ9Up8vbUV6pXKsRcKYd9BiW3oe3Nb0UF-L7FHa9CkFd6GS2_TfIELmU3km2skE3IUIcotGI3S7s-3NPfXFXXJNlxkJBbzZl8l-vxvBfSIByQgW-3ZPjwRxQ4uRVc1OcvcTU5irweHDhNd3tzJMtXgPfvwIuE6IWf9XzALF0k3shX9pTq0Bqft88pRp1RaKr5z2Tg03I80LY1jNaUcZRNkiZoV4NX-eRwlPZI1y2c8-D4ZeJk8V_pYVs2uQ/4u8/cLiISgo7ShyF9u1pyW_b3A/h0/h001.ZMbVfb23R0_g3IgOmip_KDV3BH3kC2V5uaKIlh-Ii1c) | | [TAKE ACTION](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm3_pSBlTmDFVH16Ccc45FCNuU_Ly2vNFTLXn2V-tfVw_RLtdX7DqsGBgXH38fGpQZis4jc0bhLU-wTYn5acTK9OrZ0YetB4cSxC6bntsT4xJMhLx_1Iyduqz0uQVYJHjiAji7KaRrwDsyr1V5kmxC7E34liN3jTkH2bETcLHhc3RbIt3opqGhMu0JJRj9rT3r-W9TSV0boUF5zOoTC553T0x8HOyqI8uyIpnvZxCIHpbL7j2s2gNAbW8vrDuFSwyllS0UCUupqTEhAPGklNZzYHi-Feagp04Ao8lphGx758ooEtXA-Y9xjsampw0LuWAuiYAWzrWLlRVA4TJiI3HtVItLwyohQBu_-67gbkxeN4QK4ny29Bpn9qSKEl6CzhM0z6HmYu1menj28VEZH6iL2mGB658dSOl6tQc5xRXpvMYg0iStyuwdR5Zzv8PZN-HzxmbQoTQ-8mQNLOmRwwvU2K3L8eJXFBpJtiP0HSPyX8apQ/4u8/cLiISgo7ShyF9u1pyW_b3A/h1/h001.lNIP2uuLVI8q48k6-ZoX0b5HC5RG_hj9wKg6lO-o2AQ)
---
State attorneys general in Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, Massachusetts, Minnesota, Nevada, New Jersey, New Mexico, New York, Oregon and Washington joined forces in the lawsuit to block the deal, and **the court froze the deal pending a March 2027 trial**. Paramount cannot close while its legality is contested, and some analysts don’t think the deal can survive the wait.
The Ellisons are battling the clock, too: in one month, Paramount starts paying Warner shareholders **$650 million per quarter** if the deal isn’t closed. Seven million dollars a day. Larry Ellison personally backed $40.4 billion of the equity financing. So the Ellisons have asked a federal judge to force the states to **post a $1.88 billion bond** , their estimate of potential losses due to the injunction — a pressure campaign designed to force the AGs to settle before trial.
That’s why **our support for the AGs matters so much**. History shows that merger concessions are unenforceable, frequently abandoned, and they fail to protect workers, consumers, and the free expression the public depends on. **A promise made in 2027 will not restrain an empire in 2040.** Only a trial can. Twelve attorneys general hold that line.
[**Tell state attorneys general to stand firm: no settlement, no concessions, no censorship empire. This case belongs in front of a judge — #NoConcessions.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm3_pSBlTmDFVH16Ccc45FCNuU_Ly2vNFTLXn2V-tfVw_RLtdX7DqsGBgXH38fGpQZis4jc0bhLU-wTYn5acTK9OrZ0YetB4cSxC6bntsT4xJMhLx_1Iyduqz0uQVYJHjiAji7KaRrwDsyr1V5kmxC7E34liN3jTkH2bETcLHhc3RbIt3opqGhMu0JJRj9rT3r-W9TSV0boUF5zOoTC553T0xvHmBsGNeABkSDEwJ5JvOV5yJ6y6chIl1tLSHowdUubnkVL3DSMETz07CpGfzIs0h6nguPHfxW3KSN2fvtgTCbzU2UIWZO84eNxYw4UNpN8wev67LNMVqkhHKYmxhHy1mzaGS9QCoIMMGUNUZaOl68cI95tlHApe8t5te6_u5Hh5FZCQEeTN934xp0njjerL1CR3pQ41je4v_H0gC6AchZ7Fv7Bq2T0k4wlKuZHUBL169_dLNHUubGcT7wgW8TSs7AbELT847LOdBo5scap3nAQ/4u8/cLiISgo7ShyF9u1pyW_b3A/h2/h001.sDdQllkCUmmmTqrgnr1xgC9r5kTRSn4bYYd9z37grL0)
Thank you for fighting back against the oligarch Ellisons’ attempt to take over our media landscape.
Robert Reich

| | Dear Friend who has common sense, I'm always going to stand with America. I'm always going to reject the extremes. I'm always going to reject Socialism. I'm always going to fight against the anti-American way of life. And this has enraged a lot of people in the media, in my party, and even former staffers --- disgruntled leakers who are viciously and anonymously attacking me. This is what happens when you put common sense and the wellbeing of the people you are supposed to represent ahead of party loyalty. But most of all, I think this is what happens when you clash with the Socialist movement "DSA!" that is hijacking the Democratic party. They want to... Abolish our borders Abolish the electoral college Abolish Israel Abolish the Senate and the Supreme Court (no, seriously, this is in the "DSA!" platform) That bad news is the "DSA!" crazies have gone from the political fringe to controlling one of America's major political parties—and onto ballots across the country. The good news is the hardworking, common-sense Americans I talk to every day still aren't buying it. I mean, a recent Rasmussen poll kind of proves it: 71% of Americans reject socialism 67% of Democrat voters reject socialism While 82% of Republican voters reject socialism But here's the thing. The loudest voice in the room is often the one that looks the most powerful. And I've got to say, the "DSA!" voices in Washington are loud and getting louder. The media is their megaphone. Which is why you may be under the false impression that people really do want the "DSA!" and their extreme policies Nothing could be further from the truth. **[I'm standing up to them.](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjUwMDZ9AAwAAAAAAxUCmJv93IuhkXa5pNrYJ0rXyHeOoB7dEFHQj4pi8JlTiEFt1KZsFzwn2ae2cMcqx_neKAHnTuusq1pA4q2ymsJQePixGIfmLplKIB6_)** But sadly I'm pretty much alone on this side of the aisle. So, can I ask you a favor? Whatever your party affiliation is, can I ask you to stand with me against the daily barrage of hit-pieces **[If you can donate just $25 it would be a big help to me.](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjUwMDZ9AAwAAAAAAxUCmJv-kc0rijABvfH6QkL-ZT2oLyGvb4_v4_LqngnUmOP7l0RDYRVCP2sDX-McV88EaA4hEv9sfzEaDV0A0IDs1W47wuGPf5tD5uly)** But it will also send a message. It will show the truth that the "real numbers" are on our side here in Pennsylvania, as well as around the rest of America. You know, I recently stood in front of the iconic U.S. Steel Mill and recorded a video talking about how my friend Dave McCormick and I banded together with President Trump to save this facility and the larger steel industry. But I'm not backing down. Even though I know the media... the "DSA!"... and the party bosses... are going to try even harder to defeat me:
---
**"Fetterman Draws Shadow Primary From Democrats Eager to Replace Him: The Pennsylvania senator has long irked members of his own party" ~ Bloomberg**
---
If you'll stand with me today, I know we can show them that we're not backing down and that the real numbers are on the side of common sense and putting our country first. Thank you! John Fetterman P.S. - I'll bet you're more than a little surprised to get this email from me. So, I want to say thanks for setting aside party affiliation for a second and hearing me out. You see, I'm not a progressive. And I'm definitely not a Democratic Socialist. I'm just a senator with a big mouth who happens to stand for common-sense things like... strong borders, safe streets, a powerful economy, bringing jobs to my constituents, and Israel and Ukraine's right to defend themselves, not to mention the basic machinery of our democracy (the Electoral College, the Senate, and the Supreme Court). If you see eye-to-eye with me, then I could sure use your help. The "DSA!" vision for Pennsylvania and for America is not a healthy one. It is a dangerous one.Common-sense people need to join together now to reject this vision before it's too late. **[Can I count on you to stand with me today?](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjUwMDZ9AAwAAAAAAxUCmJv_yIxYveKAixalTxmAjv2BmyyfhHfVZZQQe-mIGaOcvnXG57E7aaOi_F7Je7J5OEgxCR0KgykiNs3c6dZLMnP2R_-20VhRMI1W)**

body:
California will stop him at every opportunity.

Donald Trump won’t stop until he can exert dictatorial control over your free vote and disenfranchise millions of people this November.
California will stop him at every opportunity.
Last week I signed a dozen nation-leading bills to protect and defend our democracy from attacks by the Trump administration this November.
Here's what they do:
1️⃣ Makes it a felony to seize ballots or to direct another person to seize ballots, election records or voting technology.
2️⃣ Makes it a felony for a person with authority to direct someone they oversee to interfere with the delivery of vote by mail ballots.
3️⃣ Makes it a crime to take election materials or voting technology from the custody of election officials.
**[I recorded a short video on the topic I think it's important for you to see.](https://act.gavinnewsom.com/go/11092?t=1&akid=3031%2E4767699%2ENmiaGl)**
[](https://act.gavinnewsom.com/go/11092?t=2&akid=3031%2E4767699%2ENmiaGl)
We did our part to stop Trump from rigging the election by redistricting his way to a House majority in November. Now we're doing our part to make sure he can't play games with our ballots.
Gavin Newsom

New Mexico is home to some of the most important elections in the country this November. There's a Senate race, a battleground House race, a gubernatorial race and more.

On August 20, 2026, Ericka Lomick -- the Democratic nominee for Texas House District 93 -- signed her application for a place on the special election ballot called by Governor Abbott after Rep. Nate Schatzline's July resignation. Under the section labeled "Felony Conviction Status," she checked the box stating: "I have not been finally convicted of a felony."
A reporter obtained 144 pages of her federal criminal file. That sentence on the application is the only part of her record she couldn't find.
Because on January 4, 2011, in the Western District of North Carolina, Ericka L. Flood -- also known as Ericka Lomick -- entered a plea agreement admitting guilt to three federal charges: conspiracy to defraud the United States, bank fraud, and money-laundering conspiracy. The scheme ran from late 2006 through mid-2008: recruiters used straw buyers to purchase homes at inflated prices, skimming differences of $30,000-$60,000 per property and using the same buyers on multiple loans. Court records name Lomick/Flood as a promoter in the scheme who used her assumed name to receive kickbacks from bank employees...

name: Voto Latino
subject: 3 in 5 young adults in Texas are unregistered. We’re changing that.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Voto Latino
body:
Voto Latino teamed up with MS NOW at UT Austin to register student voters.
#
Peter,
Last week during National Voter Registration Day, Voto Latino registered students at the University of Texas at Austin!
**Latinos make up over 40% of Texas's population, yet 3 in 5 young adults in the state remain unregistered.** That's why, in collaboration with MS NOW, UT Austin’s VL On-Campus organization, and Phi Iota Alpha Fraternity and Lambda Theta Alpha Latin Sorority, Inc., we helped hundreds of students verify their status and get ready for November.
[](https://act.votolatino.org/go/57?c0=em-ms-voto-20260921-1.trI7pz&amount=3&refcode=em20260921-606&t=1&akid=606%2E1366028%2Ef4mXby) | [](https://act.votolatino.org/go/57?c0=em-ms-voto-20260921-1.trI7pz&amount=3&refcode=em20260921-606&t=2&akid=606%2E1366028%2Ef4mXby)
---|---
Many students told us they aren't sitting out because they lack interest; they care deeply about healthcare, good jobs, and student debt. They just need support and resources to register and make a voting plan.
Our work in Texas is far from over, Peter. We have more activations and voter registration drives from now until Texas’s voter registration deadline on October 5th.
**[Will you chip in $3 right now to help us have the resources to drive voter registration across Texas?](https://act.votolatino.org/go/57?c0=em-ms-voto-20260921-1.trI7pz&amount=3&refcode=em20260921-606&t=3&akid=606%2E1366028%2Ef4mXby)**

Thank you,
Voto Latino

Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country.

Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. These restrictions particularly affect disadvantaged communities and people of color. My fellow Americans - it is Vice President JD Vance.
[This is a longer email, but I respectfully ask you to read it start to finish.](http://links.maga-conservatives.com/u/click?_t=da215d85003f407c964bf56cae76557f&_m=83d6a2f2cf7d45aebbb14403a0b4db03&_e=Wzmj3O3kIZk4nUzzquNHb6B_uSUkcKIOX9pPRvBi9jTk8Au1KS41E1Dw6xoEy_FHkJV0d05FVjoRP_-rZRl1Cyf6mxEeoD9PE7BSD5cnwz7nOlNZ4x4pVC9HT3IrbeWKwzom4AQ2Gf4qawBG3QEkz8Zhil26JzepdnBjXRez3zCtBwBbFeWiuxTpIpalHaR-eF4RH4NC5baxyYF8rYUZo3oM3567DmcZZ2oI92lr84x5OVswqXWGU9KR3kb-FpzNpPpEZaw0Kk--OgzQW3YHwBmI7EtArU50K-etcQN1ldUFe-yTZUb3bb8RN6A5GxNTIIa6KMjsdzQJWx4iK4CbG5c0yNlC1F7zcrg93Gbbotkno_vK2hekRglxY6ZCiXa5JcLKH3NLUn2i-58bsAYtBDrsdcbBJBZUCRR3dIX7JtOlQFc5DPIIeRtYeXgh4YdqtveC2dYly9NVTKUDB9CUbGa4u_6_Kp5OeuixM-tWKT2yuf_HyeKUBA6_2bmVCAGgQVfohU3nSQGfFrUxYzRFbIZWRG3zi7RPvZu9FRSxOt9xKhiEFWYN4mTaiPHwppKX0pPhlW8yT5jZx2ixLErtdyzj4DV6P3FfONAy_i0PsTrrq1InqbqVUm7MIvJrNrYIYEHUQUJBheCNrOk8GJuwLR99frADy82t2KN8679UvOttUZoroBG25ooelDphgLDHffxnEbNA1yawnxeOk7_Ikg%3D%3D)
It wasn't easy telling the world I grew up dirt poor, I was raised by my Mamaw while my mother struggled with addiction.
It wasn't exactly the prep school/trust fund/summer-in-the-Hamptons upbringing that is commonplace in DC.
But I felt God called me to tell my story. Warts and all. I felt led to speak out because I believe millions of Americans share stories like mine. Stories of jobs being outsourced to China, addiction ravaging communities and killing our neighbors, and heeding the call of duty after the Towers fell on 9/11.
As your Vice President, I now stand in the breach for the left-behind, forgotten men and women who built this country, but were abandoned by the political class in DC.

Since you're a reader of Drop Site News, you probably are aware that we are, more or less, the only Western news outlet that offers any serious investigative coverage of Pakistan's authoritarian descent. We consider it scandalous that a nuclear-armed country of 250 million people receives so little attention. But we also have to be honest that we understand why that's the case. Audiences aren't used to it, and only with regular reporting can we get them there, creating a chicken-and-egg problem that can only be solved by contributions from readers who do understand why it's so important. Aleema Khan, Uzma Khan, and Noreen Niazi, sisters of jailed former Prime Minister Imran Khan, walk with supporters during a protest in Rawalpindi, Pakistan, December 9, 2025. Photo: REUTERS/Salahuddin.
Police in Lahore detained former Pakistani Prime Minister Imran Khan's three sisters, Aleema Khan, Noureen Niazi, and Dr. Uzma Khan, along with their children, on Sunday, as Khan's party, Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf (PTI), prepares to march on Islamabad on September 27 to demand his release.
Imran Khan's health has deteriorated significantly over the past few months after more than three years in prison. His primary healthcare provider, Dr. Faisal Sultan, has not been allowed to visit him for several weeks. In their last meeting, Imran Khan told his sister Uzma Khan that he is subjected to "absolute inhumane treatment." The Telegraph [reported](https://substack.com/redirect/873ed0af-4d72-44a6-bfa0-d07762f38902?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) her saying, "He told me to tell people outside that they are being unjust to me, they don't listen to me, these are not humans."
In all, eight members of his family were detained within 24 hours. The children were released after a few hours of detention, Aleema Khan's son Shershah Khan told Drop Site, but Khan's sisters remain in custody.
Simultaneously, several elected leaders of PTI were also arrested, and party offices were raided in a nationwide crackdown ahead of the September 27 march.
At the same time, Islamabad's hospitals were placed on emergency footing. Documents obtained by Drop Site show that federal health authorities issued instructions before the planned protest, directing hospitals to prepare for a potential "humanitarian crisis" and "mass casualty incident" in Islamabad.

The measures have now started to affect the patients in Islamabad hospitals. On Monday, patients scheduled for surgeries were told that their procedures would be postponed, according to people familiar with the situation. The surgical departments are to be reconfigured for a potential influx of casualties. "All scheduled elective (planned) surgical procedures are postponed indefinitely," the documents state.
All forms of leave for medical, nursing, paramedical, administrative, and support staff have been suspended, while employees already on leave have been recalled immediately. To do this, patients that hospitals consider to be "stable," or recovering are being discharged from the hospitals.
The instructions to hospitals show that the government is yet again preparing a brutal crackdown on protestors. In a similar protest in November 2024, the Pakistani military killed dozens of PTI protestors using live rounds and snipers on the gathered crowds in the middle of the night. A Drop Site [investigation](https://substack.com/redirect/eb3acc13-700f-4a46-98ad-ad12f964183d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) from the time showed that the Pakistani military had planned the crackdown on the protestors. The military later successfully covered up the total number of casualties from the incident and [arrested](https://substack.com/redirect/004adfba-5d13-45c6-87f2-cd3d46f975d0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) journalists trying to investigate.
Imran Khan has been in prison [since](https://substack.com/redirect/d68d085a-ca94-439a-90dd-039e27b2c0da?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) August 2023 after a vote of no confidence was used to overthrow his government. In these three years, several human rights organizations have called his imprisonment a case of arbitrary detention, and the military leadership of Pakistan has cracked down on members of his party all over the world. In August, concerns about Khan's health reached a crescendo when he was taken to PIMS (Pakistan Institute of Medical Sciences). Earlier this year, he [reportedly](https://substack.com/redirect/0abbbe22-7b4c-4b65-a359-89b39a634512?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) lost 85% vision in his right eye. Khan's wife has also been facing multiple health issues in prison, under solitary confinement similar to Khan, including the complete loss of vision in one eye, according to her sister.
Aleema Khan's arrest was backed by a formal order by the deputy commissioner of Lahore and obtained by Drop Site News, which authorized the detention of Aleema Khan and her driver, Muhammad Ameer, for 30 days under Section 3 of the Maintenance of Public Order (MPO). A similar order circulated on social media alleging similar charges against Noreen Niazi and Uzma Khan. The MPO has been used repeatedly to subdue protests by detaining organizers and accusing them of threatening public safety.
Hours after Aleema's arrest, her son Shershah Khan [announced](https://substack.com/redirect/5ccdf2c4-39fc-40fb-9e7d-20430062d093?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on social media that police had surrounded the family's Lahore residence. In Lahore, Aleema and Uzma Khan's houses share a wall. Sources close to the family who requested anonymity for safety reasons confirmed that officers remained stationed outside for several hours before the rest of the family was arrested and driven to an undisclosed location in armored vehicles.
"We only found out through social media that they took her under MPO; we have no information about where they have taken her," Noreen Niazi said in a [press conference before she was arrested. ](https://substack.com/redirect/5d1f0c0d-7ff3-41af-a395-fc129c2fb608?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)"They don't realize September 27 will be a huge day; we are all a part of the movement for Imran Khan's freedom."
Photographs of Uzma Khan's bedroom door. Provided to Drop Site by Imran Khan's family.
Later that day, a member of the family told Drop Site News, they forcibly entered Uzma Khan's home as well. "Uzma Khan has a heart condition; she was sleeping when two hundred men entered her house and broke down her bedroom door." Uzma Khan wears a hijab, but, the family reported, the police did not allow her to cover herself while she was being detained. "These women are in their late sixties and mid-seventies, but their bags were packed since they knew something like this could happen before the 27th," he said.
Despite the arrests, the family insisted the march should continue as planned. "They don't need a case. They don't need the facade of an order," said Imran Khan's nephew. "The people of Pakistan should step out for their own freedom."
Sameer Khosa, a prominent lawyer of the Supreme Court, spoke to Drop Site about the legal implications of the MPO. "In recent years, it has been used to prevent protests and detain political opponents when there is no other ground of arrest available," he said. "It is not surprising that it has been used in this case in advance of a call to protest."
"Imran Khan's sisters have been outspoken in the past to bring attention to his solitary confinement, deteriorating health, and deprivation of his meetings with family members and lawyers," said Khosa. "This is clearly an attempt to contain any galvanizing figures in advance of the September 27 long march."
The general secretary of PTI and the head of their legal affairs, Salman Akram Raja, told Drop Site, "There is this law, MPO, which has been challenged several times as unconstitutional, but it has been struck down, but it has been revived." He further added, "This is a pathetic attack on Imran Khan's family; it is completely unacceptable, and similar attacks have been happening all across Punjab. Pakistan has become a fascist state effectively, so nobody's life, liberty is safe."
The sisters are being represented by lawyers Taimur Malik and Rana Mudassar, who aim to file a habeas petition in the next few days. In a press conference today, senior party leader Barrister Gohar Khan confirmed the long march will go as planned.
"In the four years since our government was overthrown, we have not been allowed a single long march," he said. "We have gone to the high courts 25 times and 19 times to the Supreme Court. We raised our voice in the parliament and the senate, but it has fallen on deaf ears."
According to Gohar, 1,500 workers, five parliamentarians, and one minister have been abducted just this week.
In a video posted on social media, the Chief Minister of Pakistan's Khyber Pakhtunkhwa (KP) province, Sohail Afridi, recorded a [message](https://substack.com/redirect/c1cb06ea-73b0-4757-836b-a475c435abf0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) condemning the arrest of Khan's sisters. He said security forces have been attacking party infrastructure all over the province and that they also tried to abduct a provincial minister.
PTI leader Taimur Jhagra confirmed this to Drop Site. "Yesterday there was an incident where a provincial minister was followed by masked men and people got injured in the firing," he said. "Another KP MPA (Member of Provincial Assembly) was picked up from his house in Islamabad."

The general secretary of PTI and the head of their legal affairs, Salman Akram Raja, told Drop Site, "There is this law, MPO, which has been challenged several times as unconstitutional, but it has been struck down, but it has been revived." He further added, "This is a pathetic attack on Imran Khan's family; it is completely unacceptable, and similar attacks have been happening all across Punjab. Pakistan has become a fascist state effectively, so nobody's life, liberty is safe." The sisters are being represented by lawyers Taimur Malik and Rana Mudassar, who aim to file a habeas petition in the next few days. In a press conference today, senior party leader Barrister Gohar Khan confirmed the long march will go as planned. "In the four years since our government was overthrown, we have not been allowed a single long march," he said. "We have gone to the high courts 25 times and 19 times to the Supreme Court. We raised our voice in the parliament and the senate, but it has fallen on deaf ears." According to Gohar, 1,500 workers, five parliamentarians, and one minister have been abducted just this week. In a video posted on social media, the Chief Minister of Pakistan's Khyber Pakhtunkhwa (KP) province, Sohail Afridi, recorded a condemning the arrest of Khan's sisters. He said security forces have been attacking party infrastructure all over the province and that they also tried to abduct a provincial minister. PTI leader Taimur Jhagra confirmed this to Drop Site. "Yesterday there was an incident where a provincial minister was followed by masked men and people got injured in the firing," he said. "Another KP MPA (Member of Provincial Assembly) was picked up from his house in Islamabad." Addressing Imran Khan's sisters' detention, Jhagra said, "It is, sadly, a reflection of a Pakistan today with an illegitimate setup, where everything from the constitution to the judiciary, the bureaucracy to the media, are all controlled and able to flaunt the law as they want it." Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi, who is a trusted friend of Field Marshall Asim Munir, has vowed the government "will not leave any loopholes" in its response if the party proceeds with the long march. "Do not harm yourself and your workers," he threatened. Aqeedat Chishty contributed reporting. | A guest post by| journalist, fact checker, researcher, and socialist feminist. My name is Emily, and I'm a ballot chaser for Turning Point PAC in Arizona.

That means every day, I show up, knock on doors, have conversations with potential voters, and chase down ballots before Election Day.

I need to tell you what I'm seeing out here, because I don't think most people understand how close this really is.

**Arizona is not lost._Not even close_. But it is not safe either.**

A new poll just showed Katie Hobbs up by 4 points over Andy Biggs.

We chase every ballot, mail-in or in person, because every single one counts.

But I cannot do this alone, and neither can the 700 of us out here across Arizona.

clean_body: Friend, My name is Emily, and I'm a ballot chaser for Turning Point PAC in Arizona. That means every day, I show up, knock on doors, have conversations with potential voters, and chase down ballots before Election Day. I need to tell you what I'm seeing out here, because I don't think most people understand how close this really is. Arizona is not lost.Not even close. But it is not safe either. A new poll just showed Katie Hobbs up by 4 points over Andy Biggs. Four points. That is the entire ballgame, sitting right there behind the doors I have not knocked on yet. Turning Point PAC is not like anything else in this space. They take decades of grassroots organizing and put real people, like me, into these communities well before Election Day. We build relationships. We knock on the same doors more than once. We chase every ballot, mail-in or in person, because every single one counts. This is the vision Charlie Kirk built. People on the ground, having real conversations, changing real minds. And it is working! But I cannot do this alone, and neither can the 700 of us out here across Arizona. I 'm seeing momentum on the ground, but we have so many more voters to cover. We can't do it without your continued support. Every $50 you give sponsors a ballot chaser like me for one full day. That's about 75 doors and 25 real conversations with voters who haven't made up their minds yet, and who deserve to hear from us before it's too late. For America and for Charlie, A Turning Point PAC Arizona Ballot Chaser Paid for by Turning Point PAC Arizona. Not authorized by any candidate or agents acting on any candidate's behalf. Washington doesn’t have a revenue problem. It has a spending problem.

Year after year, Congress spends far beyond its means. The national debt keeps climbing. Interest payments alone now consume a massive share of the budget. And the people who always get stuck with the bill are hardworking American taxpayers.

clean_body: Do you want our debt passed on to your kids, Friend? | Friend, Washington doesn’t have a revenue problem. It has a spending problem. Year after year, Congress spends far beyond its means. The national debt keeps climbing. Interest payments alone now consume a massive share of the budget. And the people who always get stuck with the bill are hardworking American taxpayers. The solution from the Radical Left is always the same: raise taxes and keep spending. They treat the American people’s wallets as an endless resource. That approach has failed. Getting our finances back in order requires something far more basic and far more difficult: real restraint. Congress must get serious about reining in reckless spending and treating the hard-earned money of the American people with respect. I’m not talking about cutting essential services or abandoning those in need. It is about ending waste, stopping the endless expansion of government, and refusing to pass an unsustainable debt onto our children and grandchildren. Too many politicians talk about fiscal responsibility only when the cameras are off. I’m saying it publicly and clearly. We need sustained pressure, stronger majorities of fiscal conservatives, and the political will to actually say no to the next round of reckless spending. | Thank you Friend, Rep. One week later, a Sikh truck driver was followed into a rest stop bathroom in Wyoming and stabbed 17 times. Twice in the neck. Twice in the chest. Luckily, he survived. I don't know exactly what was in his attacker's head. Officials are still investigating. But I know this: "Singh" is one of the most common last names among Sikh Americans, worn by more than 100,000 people in this country. **When the federal government singles out that name and pairs it with "get off our roads," it doesn't stay contained to one policy debate. It tells people watching that an entire community is fair game.** This is not the first time. I've had a sitting elected official call for the mass deportation of Indians and label me a "foreign occupier." I've watched a demonstrator tear an Indian flag apart while a crowd chanted hate. Every time, we're told it's rhetoric, it's just politics, it doesn't really mean anything. Tell that to a man recovering in a Wyoming hospital. Words from the government carry weight precisely because they come from the government. When DHS puts out an image mocking a man's name and his ability to drive because of what he looks like, it doesn't just offend people. It makes them targets. They put his name on a government post. He ended up in a hospital bed, stabbed 17 times. If there isn't a cost, then rhetoric like this will keep coming, and someone else will pay the price next. I am done accepting this as the price of doing politics in this country. Equal Opportunity Now exists to elect leaders who will make sure it isn't free — leaders who will call this out the moment it happens and fight to hold the people responsible accountable. **[Chip in $25 or $50 right now.
