body:
Election Day is 43 days away, and these are the places that can benefit most from financial support right now.
#
Hi there,
In case you missed it last week, Swing Left’s [**Immediate Impact Fund**](https://act.swingleft.org/go/27?c0=immediate-impact-2026.DM5m6O&refcode=em20260921-2855&t=1&akid=2855%2E1562180%2EOJeWen) is back!
The fund includes a slate of Must-Flip and Must-Hold races, caucus committees, and state parties that need funds most right now, and we update it weekly based on our political team's latest analysis.
Since its launch last week, this community has already raised over $100,000 for these races, with one campaign reporting that Immediate Impact Fund gifts were **the biggest source of online contributions on launch day**. We’re already making a meaningful difference!
The current Immediate Impact Fund slate includes:
* Jonathan Nez, AZ-02 - Must-Flip House Race
* Jake Johnson, MN-01 - Must-Flip House Race
* Shannon Taylor, VA-01 - Must-Flip House Race
* Kathy Castor, FL-14 - Must-Hold House Race
* Don Davis, NC-01 - Must-Hold House Race
* Marcy Kaptur, OH-09 - Must-Hold House Race
* Troy Jackson, ME-SEN - Must-Flip Senate Race
* Josh Turek, IA-SEN - Must-Flip Senate Race
* David Crowley, WI-GOV - Must-Hold Governor Race
* Pennsylvania House Democratic Campaign Committee - Must-Hold State Legislative Chamber
* NH House Democratic Victory Campaign Committee - Must-Flip State Legislative Chamber
* Michigan Democratic Party - Key State Partner

When you invest in the [**Immediate Impact Fund**](https://act.swingleft.org/go/27?c0=immediate-impact-2026.DM5m6O&refcode=em20260921-2855&t=2&akid=2855%2E1562180%2EOJeWen), your donation is immediately deployed to the frontline battlegrounds that will decide control of Congress and states across the country.
Thank you for supporting these races in this final stretch.
— The Swing Left Team
P.S. If you want to learn more, you can read our email from last week below!

\-------- Forwarded message --------
From: Swing Left
Subject: The 12 places money is needed most, based on our conversations with campaigns
Hi there,
There are fewer than 50 days left until Election Day. This is when campaigns are in make-or-break mode. And with so much noise out there about hundreds of candidates, it can be hard to understand where your dollars and time can make the biggest difference in winning back Congress and key state legislatures to swing the national balance of power.
**Which is why we’re excited to announce that the[Immediate Impact Fund is back.](https://act.swingleft.org/go/27?c0=immediate-impact-2026.DM5m6O&refcode=em20260921-2855&t=3&akid=2855%2E1562180%2EOJeWen)**
[****](https://act.swingleft.org/go/27?c0=immediate-impact-2026.DM5m6O&refcode=em20260921-2855&t=4&akid=2855%2E1562180%2EOJeWen)
**If you want to have an instant impact on the closest races this year, the Immediate Impact Fund is the place to give.** Your donation will go directly to the Democratic candidates, state parties, and caucus committees that will benefit most from an infusion of cash, right now.
We first introduced the Immediate Impact Fund during the 2018 midterm elections, and every cycle since, it has been one of the key ways that this community has helped Democrats beat Republicans to win majority-making swing seats.
The Immediate Impact Fund is informed by Swing Left’s political team, which is in daily conversations with campaigns for House, Senate, and governors’ races, as well as Democratic State Parties and downballot races. They chose these races based on rigorous analysis, including the latest polling data, fundraising reports, and direct conversations with campaigns about what they need revenue for right now.
As we move closer to November 3rd, our team will continuously monitor spending, polling, and campaign field reports. Each Wednesday, as races shift, the Swing Left political team will share an update straight to your inbox on the Immediate Impact Fund with a refreshed slate of candidates and entities where your dollars will go furthest.
This week, the Immediate Impact Fund includes a dozen campaigns and entities, including six must-win U.S. House races like **Arizona's 2nd**. Polls show that former Navajo Nation President Jonathan Nez is in a neck-and-neck race with his Republican incumbent opponent in a massive, rural district. Indigenous voters are the key to victory for Nez, but they face unique barriers to voting on the Navajo reservation, where voters must travel long distances to vote with limited transportation, lack Internet access, have spotty mail service, and other obstacles. As a result, the campaign needs enormous resources to reach and mobilize voters.
It also includes two must-flip Senate races—one of which is **Iowa, where Democratic candidate Josh Turek’s** opponent ended the quarter with nearly three times as much cash, making immediate grassroots funding vital so he has the resources to talk to voters in every corner of the state.
**When you give to the Immediate Impact Fund today, you give these frontline campaigns, state parties, and caucus committees the funds they need to stay competitive in the lead-up to the midterms.**
**[If you want to make a difference in the races and places that need support the most right now, donate to the Immediate Impact Fund today. Your contribution will go directly to the 12 races, caucus committees, and state parties in our initial slate.](https://act.swingleft.org/go/27?c0=immediate-impact-2026.DM5m6O&refcode=em20260921-2855&t=5&akid=2855%2E1562180%2EOJeWen)**
**[Donate Now](https://act.swingleft.org/go/27?c0=immediate-impact-2026.DM5m6O&refcode=em20260921-2855&t=6&akid=2855%2E1562180%2EOJeWen)**
Thank you for supporting these critical races–we’ll be in touch with more soon.
— The Swing Left Team

**Since 2017, Swing Left has channeled the energy of grassroots volunteers and donors to elect Democrats, up and down the ballot, focusing on the most competitive races that can swing the national balance of power.** Right now, Swing Left is investing in grassroots organizing in key swing districts and initiatives across the country to flip the House and win the Senate and critical states in 2026. [**If you’d like to help support our work, you can make a donation using this link.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_sl_footer?refcode=em20260921-1&t=7&refcode2=2855_1562180_OJeWen&akid=2855%2E1562180%2EOJeWen)

body:
What is the military value of a fortified arch looming over Arlington National Cemetery? What is it defending? From who?
#
Peter:
[](https://act.votevets.org/go/2927?c0=vv-pac-em-sep26.f1bOKp&refcode=em260921-1-180&t=1&akid=35604%2E3013755%2E_pzBq2)

name: Judicial Watch Tipsheet
subject: Judicial Watch Uncovers Anti-Charlie Kirk Emails at Utah University Following His Assassination
body:
Judicial Watch announced that it obtained 133 pages of records from Utah Valley University (UVU) through a Utah Government Records Access and Management Act (GRAMA) request revealing sharply anti-Charlie Kirk messages from individuals identified as university faculty or instructors in the weeks following Kirk’s assassination on the UVU campus.

clean_body: Hollywood liberals are lining up behind my opponent. Help me stop them. | 🚨 BREAKING 🚨 Fellow Patriot - I wish this wasn't the news I had to send to you. We just found out that a dark money Democrat Super PAC just launched a $2.5 million ad buy attacking me. Dr. Annie Andrews is already controlling the airwaves. The day after I won the runoff, she placed her own ad buy - and now she has Super PACs helping her. We need to be able to drown out the lies that my opponent and her liberal comrades are blasting on South Carolinian televisions. But here's the thing, Fellow Patriot. Asking if you hate getting so many political emails is about as useful as asking if you are sick of the high costs and corruption coming from Washington. _I get it. _ Every couple of weeks, I try to offer you a more personal update, without an urgent deadline hanging over our heads (though, honestly, there’s almost always a deadline!). You have made incredible contributions to put us in a position to win, and I wish you could be on the trail with me to feel the momentum and appreciation from every corner of the district. Last week, a local parent of two teenagers told me that our campaign was the first thing that had made their kids feel genuine hope and excitement about politics. The day before that, I met with a group of veterans who thanked me and the team for “the courage to step into the arena to fight for the Constitution and freedoms they enlisted to protect.” We are giving people a real reason to believe that we will flip this seat back into the hands of the people, and flip the House back into the hands of those who believe in the rule of law. We are also working closely with an amazing slate in Lynchburg who are ready to flip their city council and school board back. **Sanity and humanity are making a comeback, and every voter we touch creates ripples of hope building into a wave of momentum.** Early voting has already begun, and we are 43 days away from Election Day – we can almost hear the sound of the clock ticking. Every voter that reminds me how much this win would mean to them also plants a seed of constructive anxiety about what it would mean to fall short. Every moment is a chance to reach more voters, recruit more volunteers, and raise more resources that allow us to... well, reach more voters and recruit more volunteers. With your help, we have been running that Sledgehammer ad, and other organizations have been hitting McGuire for his corruption. We are knocking doors every weekend, but always need to hit more. Yes, we are still pushing hard to reach our fundraising goals. And we are still burning up the roads of Central Virginia and Southside, and still hearing how angry voters are that McGuire refuses to show up for public debates or town halls. In Nelson County recently, we had a roundtable with healthcare providers, particularly those connected to mental and behavioral health needs. They were joined by local law enforcement and education leaders from across Central Virginia. We met in a rural health clinic that I landed the federal funding to expand a few years ago, and they had initially expanded the range of services they could provide to rural families under the Affordable Care Act. Now, all of that is at risk because of the big, ugly bill and the healthcare cliff coming in January. When leaders in Congress care, we really can make a difference. And when that power falls into the wrong hands, it can cause so much pain – to the middle class and those on the margins. Campaigns are exhausting, but one gift it gives is clarity of purpose. _There’s not been a single day on the trail that I have wondered whether this campaign matters._ Whether this is how I can make the most difference right now. The exhaustion is temporary – well, some of it may leave a mark – but the good we can do with a win will echo for years. I know that because I hear the echo every day of the good we did together during my brief time in DC. That is what keeps me going and makes me want to go back. Thank you so much for all of your support of this campaign and for reading these emails. With the final countdown on, please know that you have helped us to pave a path to victory. Now let’s do everything we possibly can to run through the tape. Forever grateful,Tom P.S. Of course, we would always welcome your financial support to keep us pushing toward a win, and you can contribute right here: **[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/perriello-em](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/139677108/648141622/-143260263?refcode=260921em_tp_personal-rs&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjIvMS8xMjIxMDkiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZWIzYTM0NzktMTZiNi1mMTExLWE2YTctMDAyMjQ4MmE5YThkIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=N2TUxdwtsq_8lJlzCQCHDWsTUK0xTkd_dSAItTLzReo=)**

# MEDIA ADVISORY

**FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE**
September 21, 2026

**CONTACT**
Todd Cheewing
Todd@Ascent-Strategic.com

**PRESS ADVISORY: LILY TANG WILLIAMS TO ADDRESS ROTARY CLUB OF CONCORD**

CONCORD, N.H. — Republican congressional candidate Lily Tang Williams will address the Rotary Club of Concord on Tuesday, September 22, discussing her campaign for Congress to preserve the American Dream and make Granite Staters’ lives more affordable. WHAT: Lily Tang Williams Addresses Rotary Club of Concord WHEN: Tuesday, September 22, 2026 TIME: Meeting begins at 12:00 PM; Williams expected to speak at approximately 12:30 PM, followed by Q&A WHERE: Kimball Jenkins Estate, 266 N. Main St., Concord, NH 03301 _**Members of the media are encouraged and welcome to attend.**_

**About Lily Tang Williams**
Born in China just before Mao’s Cultural Revolution to working-class parents, Lily Tang Williams immigrated to the United States with nothing and built a life as an entrepreneur, educator, and community leader in Weare, NH. A living embodiment of the American Dream, she brings a uniquely powerful perspective to the fight for freedom and limited government.

In 2024, Williams won the Republican nomination and captured 47% of the general election vote against current incumbent Maggie Goodlander — coming closer than any Republican has in more than a decade to flipping NH-02. She is back and running stronger than ever in 2026.
